title: Excalibur | Better Beginnings Support
description: Excalibur support for Better Beginnings mod
body:
This is a support pack that makes the textures of tools from the [Better Beginnings (No Tree Punching)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/better-beginnings) mod match the medieval style of [Excalibur](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/excal).

### **Features:**
- Retexture of all tools
- Retexture of rock item and block

### **Showcase:**
![Landscape](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c25d81c6a1b9163429f9d8249717290f7e90daaf.png)

### **Credit:**

- _NiceJohn_ - Author of the mod [Better Beginnings (No Tree Punching)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/better-beginnings)
